root_idea.summary: The root denotes life and continuance, and its derivatives describe the condition, means, place, or time of living.
root_idea.development: The basic notion of life extends to a lived condition and to whatever sustains life, including livelihood, subsistence, and the time or place in which sustenance is pursued.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested noun describing a state or quality of life.
Distinct Quran-attested noun used for a time or setting of subsistence.
The Quranic plural مَعَايِش is explicitly identified as the plural of مَعِيشَة and is presented under the singular dictionary citation form.
Distinct Quran-attested noun serving as the singular citation form for the normalized public entry.

senses.definition: A state, quality, or mode of life.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic contexts, the expression describes a pleasing or satisfactory life; the form is a noun of the condition in which life is lived.

senses.definition: A time or setting in which subsistence is pursued; in the Quranic usage, the daytime as a period for seeking livelihood.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun can denote a setting of subsistence more generally, while the Quranic construction presents the day as the time allotted for livelihood.

senses.definition: The means, provisions, or resources by which one lives; livelihood or subsistence.
senses.usage_conditions: The entry includes the Quranic singular and its plural مَعَايِش. The means of living may consist of sustenance, provisions, earnings, or other resources that support life.

senses.definition: A state or condition of living; in the expression مَعِيشَةً ضَنْكًا, a straitened or constrained life.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction denotes hardship or constriction in one's mode of living. Its interpretation has also been reported as the punishment of the grave or as strait sustenance in Hell.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To live; to pass one's life in a particular state; to become possessed of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb describing existence or the manner in which life is passed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To live with another or associate with him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive co-living construction, equivalent in the cited evidence to living together with someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause or enable someone to live.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative transitive verb; it may describe granting or providing life and the means to live.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To constrain oneself to obtain the means of life, or to live on barely sufficient sustenance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes subsistence with little or nothing remaining beyond what is needed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To live together with mutual sociability and affection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction describing co-existence and harmonious association.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Life; in some usage, especially animal life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a substantive as well as an infinitive noun; the qualification 'especially animal life' is a lexical specification reported in the evidence, not an absolute restriction on every occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food or staple produce by which one lives, including wheat, other grain, or bread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectally marked food sense, with regional associations reported variously for the Hijaz, Yemen, and Egypt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: That by which one lives, or the place of subsistence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote the usual or known place of subsistence as well as the means by which subsistence is obtained; the Quranic time-of-subsistence use is listed separately under the Quranic form.
An active participial adjective describing one who is alive or living.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Living well or being in a good state or condition of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Can carry the additional nuance of having ample means of living or being well provided for.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who constrains himself to obtain the means of life or has only barely sufficient sustenance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participial description of a person subsisting without surplus.

cautions: The public entry مَعِيشَة combines the Quranic singular with its Quranic plural مَعَايِش, which is normalized under the singular citation form.

The expression مَعِيشَةً ضَنْكًا has more than one reported interpretation, including a straitened life or subsistence and exegetical readings connected with the punishment of the grave or strait sustenance in Hell.
